title: Valar Atomics hero
description: A black band exactly one window tall with a full-bleed video behind. Everything sits at the bottom: a giant extra-wide heavy caps title across seven columns on the left, and a short sentence over a gold-framed mono button on the right five. Phones stack them at the bottom.
notes: always black: a `dark` scope, so it takes the theme's dark palette on a light page
needs the wide display face for the title; the media slot is cropped like object-fit: cover
name: valaratomics-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the giant caps title, one string per line (e.g. ["Heat for", "the plains"])

props.name: media
props.description: the full-bleed background video or image (cropped like object-fit: cover); empty shows a placeholder
